source.title: Skyboxes (1.0)
source.creator: Kenney
source.acquisition: User-supplied, already acquired local library; no download or purchase performed
source.attribution: Kenney credit is welcomed but not required by the supplied CC0 license
source.status: Original daytime panorama inspected and converted into the repository; runtime integration and review evidence are documented in jelly-sky.md
source.animations: Static equirectangular PNG panoramas with baked clouds and sun; no source animation clips, sunlight simulation, or day/night engine system

processing.color_conversion: Pillow Image.convert('RGB'); no palette grading or recoloring
processing.crop: None; the entire 2:1 equirectangular panorama is preserved
processing.other_changes: No painted additions, alpha extraction, or source-preview content

review.direction: Soft daytime sky, restrained sunlight and a quiet low garden horizon around the Jelly playfield
review.inspection: All five original sky panoramas, the daytime source crop, existing garden layers, and Nature Kit source preview inspected; only the daytime panorama selected
review.status: Source selection, license, original hashes and converted pixels verified; runtime framing, motion, readability and browser review are documented separately in jelly-sky.md
review.alternatives: Morning, night, alien, space, Nature Kit and particle-light assets remain source review only and are not imported
review.preview_note: Sample (Day).png and Sample (Night).png are watermarked source previews; neither is included in the runtime image
